timeline.evidenceText: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Stretch out the javelin that is in your hand toward Ai, for I will give it into your hand.”
Yahweh said to Joshua, “Stretch out the javelin that is in your hand toward Ai, for I will give it into your hand.”
For Joshua didn’t draw back his hand, with which he stretched out the javelin, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.
He had bronze shin armor on his legs, and a bronze javelin between his shoulders.

Then David said to the Philistine, “You come to me with a sword, with a spear, and with a javelin; but I come to you in the name of Yahweh of Armies, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.

They take hold of bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Zion.”
They take up bow and spear.

definitions.short: properly, something to strike with, i.e. a dart
definitions.full: H3591. kidon I. כִּידוֺן noun [masculine] dart, javelin (Late Hebrew id. ) — absolute ׳כ Josh 8:18 6 t.; כִּידֹן Jer 50:42 ; construct כִּידוֺן 1Sam 17:6 ; — dart, javelin (distinct from חֲנִית spear, lance , q. v.), בַּכּ ׳נטה (ךׅ ביד אשׁר Josh 8:18 (twice in verse), compare 8:26 ; כּ ׳רַעַשׁ Job 41:21 the rushing sound of a dart ; וּבְכ ׳וּבַחֲנִית בְּהֶרֶב 1Sam 17:45 (weapons of Goliath), כְּתֵפָיו בֵּין נְחשֶׁת ׳כ 17:6 ( חֲנִית in 17:7 ); + חֲנִית Job 39:23 also; וְכ ׳קֶשֶׁת Jer 6:23 ; 50:42 .
definitions.rootNote: from the same as 3589 ; (perhaps smaller than 2595 )
